comment_purpose: Where Claude's tokens go, as data. It holds what fills one request, how work flows from the orchestrator to workers, subagents and workflows, and the cache and compaction. It also lists the practices that move each figure. The Process page's Tokens tab is drawn from this file and the repo's own data/org.json; the drawing names no Git Crafter metric. Every doc link was read on 2026-11-03 (code.claude.com, docs.github.com, cli.github.com).
comment_usage: A figure is {metric} (an entry of data/org.json), {metric, row} (its detail rows whose label matches the regex row, summed) or {field} (a top-level number of data/org.json). A suffix is written after the value. A layer, node or practice with no figure carries a why or reads 'no metric yet'. goals rate figures that carry no target of their own. A goal is either a goal, near and direction with a goal_source, or a system and limit. The second takes systems.json's usage_goal of that limit; percent: true marks a figure already in percent of it.

layers.label: System and tools
layers.loads: every request: core instructions and tool definitions; MCP tools by name until used
layers.why: no transcript field records the system prompt's size

layers.label: CLAUDE.md and rules
layers.loads: at session start, again after /clear or /compact; path-scoped rules when a matching file is read

layers.label: Memory
layers.loads: the first 200 lines or 25 KB of MEMORY.md, every session; topic files on demand

layers.label: Skills
layers.loads: descriptions before you type; a skill's body when it is invoked
layers.why: no transcript field records skill tokens apart

layers.label: Hooks
layers.loads: a hook's output when it fires
layers.why: no transcript field records hook output apart

layers.label: History
layers.loads: the whole conversation, resent with every request
layers.why: the transcripts record a call's total, not its history apart

layers.label: Tool results
layers.loads: each batch of tool results, sent with the next request
layers.why: the transcripts record a call's total, not its tool results apart

cache.quote: Unless you choose a TTL yourself, Claude Code requests the one-hour TTL only on a Claude subscription within your plan's included usage.
Subagents fall outside the main-conversation TTL bucket, so they get five minutes even on a subscription

nodes.label: Orchestrator
nodes.tip: the session where the plan is approved; it starts the workers and merges

nodes.label: Workers
nodes.tip: each parallel session uses the plan on its own; a message to an idle one starts a full-context turn

nodes.label: Subagents
nodes.tip: own window: system prompt, the brief, CLAUDE.md, skills and tools; the parent pays the brief and the summary

nodes.label: Workflows
nodes.tip: a script's agents, each a subagent in the transcripts

edges.tip: a brief goes in, a summary comes back

ring.label: One plan for every session and agent
ring.why: no collector reads the plan's usage meter

cache_layers.label: System prompt
cache_layers.breaks: the set of loaded tool definitions changes

cache_layers.label: Conversation
cache_layers.breaks: every turn appends; compaction replaces it

compaction.label: Compacts at
compaction.quote: Models running with a native 1M window compact before the window fills, at about 967K tokens by default

goals.goal_source: the orchestrator's rule, 2026-11-03: the collector stays under about 300 REST calls a run

practices.label: /clear between unrelated tasks
/compact with a focus, at a break
CLAUDE.md under 200 lines
Short MEMORY.md, detail in topic files
Procedures in skills, not CLAUDE.md
Path-scoped rules
Maintainer notes in HTML comments
Unused MCP servers and plugins off
CLI tools over MCP
Specific prompts; files read in ranges
Command output filtered in a hook
Verbose work in a subagent, a short summary back
Haiku or Sonnet for simple subagent work
Lower effort for routine work
Model, effort and fast mode set at the start
Plan first; give Claude a check to run
A fresh session over a long resumed one
Fewer messages to idle sessions
Prompt suggestions off
Don't re-read an unchanged file
practices.tip: since Claude Code 2.1.317 (npm, 2026-11-02), reading an unchanged file again returns its full content, not a stub

practices.label: Idle sessions compact on their own
practices.tip: since 2.1.314 (npm, 2026-10-30), the Desktop Code tab summarizes a conversation of 200K+ tokens left idle; the terminal does so after about 54 minutes idle (changelog); idleCompaction false turns it off

practices.label: Count subagent tokens from 2.1.307 on
practices.tip: 2.1.307 (npm, 2026-10-21) fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage; a 14-day window read on 2026-11-03 starts 2026-10-20, by arithmetic

practices.label: A fork reuses the parent's cache: keep model and speed
practices.tip: a fork's first request reuses the parent's prompt cache; requests share a cache only when model, speed and prefix match (prompt caching, Cache scope); on most models each effort level has its own cache, though not on the 5.5 models on a subscription

practices.label: Three review rounds, then rethink the approach
practices.tip: How the Claude Code team does code review (2026-10-15): after three rounds, the reviewer asks the author to step back and reconsider the approach

practices.label: One REST bucket per login, every session
GraphQL spends its own bucket
rate_limit before and after: it is free
One GraphQL query for many reads
Conditional requests: a 304 is free
--json with --jq; --required on checks
per_page=100
gh api --cache for data fixed to a head SHA
No polling; honor x-poll-interval
A longer --interval on watches
practices.tip: gh run watch refreshes every 3 s and gh pr checks --watch every 10 s by default (cli.github.com); 3 s is 1,200 refreshes an hour by arithmetic

practices.label: --log-failed: one job's log, not the archive
rerun --failed
Merge queue: test the exact merge
practices.tip: needs a ruleset on main, which waits for the owner

practices.label: Back off on secondary limits
practices.tip: wait 60 s, or the retry-after header's seconds
